review_type: Bounded parallel specialist authors plus root editorial/math/solution audit and separate peer reviews of c05,c06,c08; internal review, not independent human academic certification

reviewed.reasoning: Root read all four complete manuscripts and exercise/solution pairs, and inspected all benchmark calculation cores. Reviewed unequal-bin density and ECDF/median conventions; index/growth/log/denominator interpretations; within/between crossproduct decomposition; normal marginal versus dependent contrast inference. Reviewed Monte Carlo sample-mean/sample-variance derivations, integrability versus finite variance, complete replication units, covariance signs in CRN/antithetic designs, equal-cost comparison, rare-event inversion and finite-generator scope. Reviewed OLS existence via projection, normal-equation sufficiency/global loss identity, rank versus fitted uniqueness, intercept condition for centered decomposition, partialling proof, change of basis, QR, leverage and off-support prediction. Reviewed observed-outcome identity, ATT/ATE selection decomposition, standardization with target-specific weights and explicit exchangeability/consistency/positivity, finite-lottery unbiasedness despite dependent assignments, mediator/direct-effect support, pretreatment collider and observational equivalence.
reviewed.arithmetic: All four chapter checkers passed the integrated run. Root independently traced the histogram shares/densities, index rebasing, covariance/difference intervals, within/between scatter sums; inventory state profits, covariance and sixfold variance reduction; normal-equation products, simple/group OLS coefficients and losses, rank family, leverage response, exact cubic evaluation and holdout counterexample; training means/selection/ATE/ATT, six lottery contrasts, mediator interventions, eight collider triples and three observationally equivalent worlds. Checkers additionally compare independent exact methods, actual delivered SVG coordinates, seeded transcript raw moments, Gram-Schmidt projections versus elimination, 117 loss perturbations, 36 extra regression grids, 104 training/support cases and 21 lotteries. Peer calculations separately confirm c05,c06,c08.
reviewed.solutions: All 32 exercises checked against exact prompts. Complete answers cover numeric, derivation, explanation, transfer and critique components. Open chart reconstruction, simulation design, forecast evaluation and identification memos include explicit criteria. Delayed checks have supplied answers or reconstructible previously solved tasks. No downstream method is silently required before instruction.
reviewed.sources: Thirteen chapter-specific NIST/ONS, Python, Owen, MIT, Boyd/Vandenberghe, Cunningham and Cinelli/Forney/Pearl primary-source entries integrated. Author retrieval records name inspected sections and limit software-version/historical claims. Root additionally inspected Owen CRN formulas, Boyd least-squares proof route and UCLA control note; c05 peer reopened all four display sources. NIST/ONS informal causal/probability/overlap language is explicitly not adopted as a general theorem. Original synthetic examples and problems are not empirical or institutional claims.
reviewed.instruction: Each chapter meets its capability/prerequisite/coverage contract, minimum two worked examples and eight complete exercise solutions, units/assumptions/boundaries, teach-back and retention. C08 has a third worked example. Four downloadable stdlib labs provide frozen synthetic inputs and README contracts. C05 adds four actual SVG figures with text descriptions and recoverable data; fixed-renderer modification limits are explicit. C06 equation classes were aligned with shared styling, and the c04 successor now links the actual c05 chapter.
reviewed.structure: Review-state build and integrated checks passed 44 available chapters and 52 HTML pages with no errors. Four new checkers included in shared verifier; all project/figure paths use the flat offline output. Full dependency acceptance is checked again after status transition. Static figure accessibility metadata and numerical coordinates checked; browser visual/mobile/print QA remains pending under the recorded restriction.

limitations: Internal specialist/coordinator/peer checks are not external academic review or learner assessment.
Synthetic laboratory outcomes do not validate real economic inputs, forecasts or causal assumptions.
The c05 renderer is explicitly a fixed-fixture teaching program; correct original SVG coordinates are not a general charting guarantee.
Browser visual/mobile/print QA remains pending; no workaround of the recorded security restriction was attempted.
Volume4 c09–c12, its assessment/project package and the remainder of the 216-chapter library are unfinished.
acceptance: Accepted by root in prerequisite order after manuscript, solution, source, instruction, numerical and structural reviews; successful final integrated build/check required before publication. This is a coherent middle batch, not a complete volume or complete library.
